record.body:
## Evidence

Reviewer expected Project.apply and cmd_apply to accept create, update, supersede, correct, and contradict and to persist each operation with continue-and-report. Observed: _apply_operation only handles create and update.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Create fix-apply-ops. Do not reopen project-ops.

payload.basis: At 206fcd0, Project._apply_operation handles create and update only; supersede, correct, and contradict raise unsupported op.
payload.claim: behavior-bug on project-ops: Project.apply must persist the NDJSON verbs the command already accepted
payload.invalidated_when: fix lands and reviewer re-run passes, or human clears
